What happens after I invite someone?
What this means
Whether a sign-off counts towards your accreditation is decided by your programme and its rules.

While an invitation, an application or a check is under way, your supervisor's status shows what stage it has reached, such as "Awaiting professional verification" or "Awaiting Wavelength approval". Pending does not mean anything failed. Wavelength cannot promise how long a review takes.
While this happens their status shows as pending. That is expected and does not mean the invitation failed. Wavelength cannot promise how long a review takes.
You are not told the supervisor's private reasons: you see that they are not available for supervision through Wavelength at present, and any open requests to them come back to you to send on.
You are offline. Nothing has changed: supervision continues until you try again with a connection.
You are offline. Your learners' records are only shown while you are connected, and are not kept on this phone.
You can always send a one-off link to someone outside Wavelength. Those records are marked as self-declared, not verified by Wavelength.

You can ask for sign-off later from a supervisor who is then eligible. Wavelength does not promise that earlier scans will count retrospectively: that depends on your programme's rules and on your supervisor.
